title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-prep-2026-07-20-evan-scratchpad
content:
Weekly sync - Serving Runtime / Infra / Console
Date: 2026-07-20 (prep notes)
Owner: Evan Chen (prep)
Attendees (expected): Priya, Alan, Maya, Josh, SRE on-call (TBD)

Goals for this meeting:
- Quick status sync across runtime/infra/console teams (10m)
- Decide autoscaling tweak for dedicated pools (15m)
- Console rollout checklist for model v1.2 (15m)
- Action items and follow-ups (10m)

Agenda (timeboxed):
1) 00:00-00:10 — Quick rundowns (each 2-3m)
   - Priya: runtime perf highlights (latency P50/P95 for gpt-small/medium)
   - Alan: infra capacity and incident summary (week-over-week)
   - Maya: console metrics, UX rollout status
   - Note to self: ask Priya about P95 spike on 7/15 (root cause hypothesis = batch sizing change)

2) 00:10-00:25 — Autoscaling policy tweak for Dedicated pools (lead: Alan)
   - Problem: underprovisioning during morning burst (customer reported higher tail latencies)
   - Proposal: increase short-burst buffer from 10% -> 25% for cpu-bound pools; reduce cooldown from 5m -> 3m for GPU pools
   - Tradeoffs to call out: cost impact vs. 99th percentile latency improvement
   - Prep: Alan to present cost delta estimate (INFRA-4123)
   - Decision: target a limited canary for two customers on 7/27 (if approved)

3) 00:25-00:40 — Console rollout checklist for model v1.2 (lead: Maya)
   - Verify model catalog entry, performance profile, and size/quantization metadata
   - Confirm canary routing policy and fallback chains (e.g., v1.2 -> v1.1 fallback)
   - Confirm UI changes: model selection dropdown, latency/cost hints, rollout toggle
   - Security: ensure KMS key visible for private deployments (TODO: Priya to confirm KMS flags)
   - Action: Maya to post final checklist in #console-rollouts by 7/21

4) 00:40-00:50 — Open issues / incidents follow-ups
   - Incident: 7/15 P95 spike (SRV-210) — current status: RCA in progress
   - Follow-up: Evan to synthesize RCA bullets and share with CS by EOD 7/21
   - Request: SRE to validate autoscaler logs for 7/15 08:00-09:30 (Alan)

5) 00:50-01:00 — Action items and next steps
   - Quick review of action owners and due dates

Action items (pre-meeting owned + follow-ups):
- Alan: produce cost-delta estimate for autoscaling tweak (INFRA-4123) — due 2026-07-22
- Priya: deep-dive on P95 spike (SRV-210) with batch-sizes and KV cache metrics — due 2026-07-21
- Maya: finalize console rollout checklist + post to #console-rollouts — due 2026-07-21
- Evan: draft RCA summary for CS + link to Confluence page — due 2026-07-21
- SRE (On-call): validate autoscaler logs for 7/15 08:00-09:30 and report anomalies — due 2026-07-22
- Josh: update customer-facing changelog draft for v1.2 (include cost/latency notes) — due 2026-07-23

Parking lot / talking points to keep brief:
- Consider auto-bumping small GPU pools during predictable morning windows (data: need to look at 3-week trend)
- Follow-up on quantization ops: coordinate with Applied ML to test 4-bit profiles on canary
- Longer-term: perf regression alerting tied to specific prompt sets (toss to "Optimize")

Notes to self (prep prompts / lines to say):
- Start by highlighting the regression impact in customer terms ("X customers saw 30% higher 99th lat"), then tie to proposed autoscale canary
- If cost delta > 10% ask for explicit sign-off from product for canary
- Suggest a 2-week canary window and rollback criteria (P95 > baseline by 15% or error rate +1%)

Draft message for meeting recap (send after meeting):
"Thanks all — short recap: approved autoscaling canary for two customers (target start 7/27), Priya to complete RCA by 7/21, Maya to post rollout checklist 7/21. Action owners: Alan, Priya, Maya, Evan, SRE, Josh. I will post meeting notes + action tracker in Confluence and ping CS."

Reminders / TODOs before the meeting:
- Pull P50/P95 charts for gpt-small/medium for last 14 days (Priya)
- Attach canary runbook to agenda (Maya)
- Confirm on-call SRE availability and whether to include them on invites (Evan)

Versioning notes / history:
- 2026-07-18: initial draft (Evan)
- 2026-07-19: added action items and JIRA links
- 2026-07-20: final prep + minor edits (status: draft; will convert to meeting notes after sync)

-- end of scratchpad (don't forget to remove this before publishing final notes)
